verdict.rationale: three.js ships a WebGLRenderer, and its current builds include both WebGL and WebGPU renderers. The docs describe a concrete WebGPU path: WebGPURenderer, compute shaders, and TSL node materials that work on both backends. Community comments independently confirm it runs WebGL in practically any browser. Missing for 10: any evidence on payload or bundle size (tree-shaking, minified size), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the WebGPU renderer is mature in production.
